text:
lena (PM): drafting a consolidated visibility plan for H2. main asks: UI dashboards, low-cost span hooks, per-route cost attribution, and better error grouping. need to rank by "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" for initial alpha.

dez (eng-runtime): runtime note: emitting spans synchronously on every request is expensive. prefer fire-and-forget batching or a sidecar. we should target <1% p99 regression for alpha.

mo (eng-sre): agreed. also propose automatic kill-switch: if node CPU > 85% for 3m after enabling hooks, disable hooks for that node. infra-bot: adding template.

infra-bot: auto-policy: {"trigger":"cpu_percent>85","duration":"3m","action":"disable_span_hooks","scope":"node"}

tasha (obs-ux): UX idea: two-tier surface - "At-a-glance" card (error rate + spend delta + key traces) and "Investigate" canvas (trace timelines, grouped errors, span detail). keep the at-a-glance minimal for new users.

rui (data-plat): cost attribution approach options: 1) deterministic attribution (full capture) -> accurate but expensive; 2) sampled capture + extrapolation -> cheaper, looser accuracy; 3) hybrid: full for high-value tenants/routes, sampled elsewhere. need to feed route metadata and model type into pipeline.

karim (acct): enterprise customers require per-route monthly CSV exports and alerting on unexpected spend. if we default to sampling, we must surface confidence intervals and a clear billing statement about approximations. sales will push for 30d raw spans for audits.

lena (PM): proposal: milestone A: telemetry primitives (id propagation, lightweight span hook, cost events). Milestone B: basic dashboards + sampled traces (alpha partners). Milestone C: full export, alerts, and tenant-level retention tiers (GA).

dez (eng-runtime): rough sizing: primitives + header propagation ~2 sprints, batch exporter ~1 sprint, sampled viewer ~1 sprint. GA features (full export + retention tiers) need infra + storage work maybe 3-4 sprints.

mo (eng-sre): rollout plan: dark-launch hooks in staging, then 0.2% prod traffic for one week, expand to 1% and monitor errors/latency/cost. acceptance: p99 regression < 2% and no unexplained spike in error rate.

tasha (obs-ux): performance SLAs for UI: at-a-glance load under 800ms, initial investigate render for sampled traces under 1.5s. show a badge when attribution is sampled vs deterministic.

rui (data-plat): retention proposal: default raw span retention 7d, aggregated metrics 90d, paid tiers: 30d and 90d raw. cold storage fetch available for 365d on request. encryption at rest + KMS for tenant keys.

karim (acct): recommend including retention pricing grid in spec. AE team will need precise price deltas.

lena (PM): launch acceptance checklist (draft):
- primitives: id propagation header present for all request types, span emission endpoint healthy, cost events emitted per request
- alpha: dashboards visible to alpha tenants, sampled traces linked to errors, no SLO regressions in canary windows
- GA: CSV export, alerts configurator, retention tiers enabled, docs & admin controls for PII redaction

dez (eng-runtime): PII note: spans must drop payload fields by default; allow tenant opt-in to capture more fields with a signed DPA. add config flags to scrub headers/body.

mo (eng-sre): also need playbook for disabling hooks per-tenant and incident runbook if rollout causes cascading congestion.

tasha (obs-ux): I'll prototype the at-a-glance card and an investigate sketch showing grouped errors and a timeline. will include copy for "confidence" indicators.

rui (data-plat): I'll produce a cost/accuracy matrix with ballpark storage and CPU numbers for each retention + sampling option.

karim (acct): I'll gather top customer asks and map to the milestones so AE can talk about the roadmap with prospects.

lena (PM): open questions before FRD: default sampling rates? which routes qualify for full capture in hybrid model? pricing specifics for retention tiers? legal signoff for tenant opt-in capture?

lena (PM): next sync tomorrow 9am PT. please drop any blockers here before EOD. thanks! :rocket:
